descriptions.w3d_message_cache_construct: Initializes a cached message identifier and clears its name flag.
descriptions.w3d_message_cache_equals: Compares a resolved cached-message identifier with an integer.
descriptions.w3d_message_id_equals_cache: Compares an integer with a resolved cached-message identifier.
descriptions.w3d_text_cache_construct: Constructs a text-backed cached message and assigns its text.
descriptions.w3d_text_cache_assign: Assigns cached text or the shared empty string and clears its resolution flag.
descriptions.w3d_callback_link: Links a callback node at the intrusive-list head and copies its member descriptor.
descriptions.w3d_callback_dispatch: Invokes member callbacks in list order until one returns an error.
